semantic.justification: Task AQF9AG ports the source OnDemandCharClass two-slot cache: matching locales reuse their classifier, an unseen locale replaces the slot opposite the current one, and GetCharClass borrows the selected classifier. Prepared Locale values stand for source LanguageTag/service construction; full LanguageTag and UNO provider ABI are still unported. Task AQF9AG adds the source lazy IGNORE_CASE transliteration owner with current-language invalidation and stable borrowed GetTransliteration accessor. AQF9AG adds original on-demand NativeNumberWrapper emplace and same-owner get lifetime. Component-context lookup remains bound through the existing actual wrapper/provider path; no stand-in service/context is supplied.
